themepack_card_title: 360p Rockbox Theme Pack sigi sen kan
themepack_card_desc: Sigida barokun cɛɲiw, kɔkannafɛnw, ani sɛbɛnnibolo minnu dilannen don kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la 360p jiralanw kama, olu bɛ a kɔnɔ.
themepack_installed_success: ✓ 360p Theme Pack sigilen don ka ɲɛ!
themepack_step1_title: 1nan : Aw bɛ ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ USB Storage Mode kɔnɔ
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Aw bɛ aw ka fɔlikɛlan daminɛ ni aw ye Power butɔni minɛ.
2. Ni Rockbox daminɛna, i ka USB kabɔri don i ka ɔridinatɛri kɔnɔ.
3. Ni ɲininkali kɛra a la fɔlikɛlan ɲɛ kan, i ka USB Storage mode dafa walasa minɛn ka jira i n’a fɔ drive.
themepack_step2_title: 2nan: Foli o Foli sugandi Player kan
themepack_step2_desc: Ikomi baarakɛminɛnw (i n’a fɔ macOS) bɛ dotfiles (i n’a fɔ .rockbox) dogo ka da a kan, i bɛ se ka ANY folder walima drive root sugandi i ka player kan. An bɛna .rockbox ɲɛbilasɛbɛn sɔrɔ an yɛrɛma walima k’a dabɔ i ye.
themepack_complete: Theme pack in sigilen don ka ɲɛ! Sisan i bɛ se k’i ka fɔlikɛlan tigɛ lafiya la ani ka barokun dɔ sugandi Rockbox kɔnɔ (Settings > Theme Settings).
themepack_err_not_found: A ma se ka .rockbox ɲɛbilasɛbɛn dɔ sɔrɔ walima k’a daminɛ disiki sugandilen kan. Aw ye aw jija ka foli dɔ sugandi aw ka fɔlikɛlan kan.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Aw bɛ tɛmɛ USB Storage Mode kan
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: 1nan : Aw bɛ fɔlikɛlan daminɛ kokura ka sɔrɔ ka a jɛ kokura
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Aw bɛ USB kabɔri tigɛ.
2. Aw bɛ se ka fɔlikɛlan fanga segin a ma ani k’a to a ka daminɛ Rockbox kɔnɔ.
3. Ni Rockbox bɛ baara la, aw bɛ USB kabɔri don a la kokura, o kɔ aw bɛ Continue digi.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Application bɛ ka ADB jɛgɛncogo kɔlɔsi (fo ka se segin 30 ma). Ni minɛn dɔ Sɔrɔla, barokunw bɛ Yɛlɛma ani fɔlikɛla bɛ Daminɛ kokura a yɛrɛma. N’o tɛ, i ka tɛmɛ ka taa USB Storage Mode la.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: ADB minɛn dɔ makɔnɔni... (fo ka se segin 30 ma) .
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: ADB minɛn si ma sɔrɔ segin 30 kɔnɔ; ka t’a fɛ ni USB Storage Mode ye.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: ADB binary si tɛ sɔrɔ app kɔnɔ; ka t’a fɛ ni USB Storage Mode ye.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Ka barokunw ni sɛbɛnnibolow gɛlɛya ADB kan...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB jiginni ma ɲɛ; ka segin ka bin USB Storage Mode kan
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: A sigi sen kan USB Storage Mode fɛ
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. USB Storage Mode (USB Storage Mode) daminɛ fɔlikɛlan kan walasa a ka bɔ i n’a fɔ disiki.
2. Foli O foli ta min bɛ fɔlikɛlan kan min bɛ duguma (.rockbox, Music, Themes, walima drive root — .rockbox foli dogolen dɔ bɛ sɔrɔ a yɛrɛma).
3. Application bɛ 360p barokunw ni sɛbɛnnibolow fara ɲɔgɔn kan, ka tɔgɔ kelen filenw sɛbɛn u kan.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Sisan, i bɛ se ka fɔlikɛlan tigɛ lafiya la ani ka barokun dɔ ta Rockbox kɔnɔ (Settings > Theme Settings).
legacy_cleanup_desc: Updater kɔrɔ dɔ bɛ ɔridinatɛri in kan hali bi, wa a bɛ disiki yɔrɔ ta. A bɔli a la, o bɛ o yɔrɔ hɔrɔnya.

legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Innioasis Updater porogaramu kɔrɔw ni dɛmɛni foli kɔrɔw bɔ yen
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Android Platform Tools (ADB / Fastboot) ka to a kɔnɔ
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Ni i tɛ baara kɛ ni ADB walima Fastboot ye Updater CE kɔkan, i ka taamasiyɛn bɔ walasa ka marayɔrɔ wɛrɛw bɔ a kɔnɔ ani ka u sɔrɔ kokura.
legacy_cleanup_btn_clean: Aw bɛ a bɔ a la
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: A ye legacy installation (dadon) kɔrɔw saniya ka ɲɛ ani disiki yɔrɔ min sɔrɔla kokura.
